title: Overall package and tech package impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the car as a strong overall package, with one complaint that the tech package feels worse than a previous 2 Series.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as an excellent overall package, including its driving modes and the M Sport package's interior comfort.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the tech package is not as good as the one in a previously owned 2 Series.

limitations: The topic is based on a very small set of short fragments, so detail on specific package features is limited.
The cluster combines broad overall-package praise with a narrower comparison about the tech package, so it is not fully uniform.
